statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-85747 is in github.com/docker/distribution registry/client: (*manifests).Get never hashes a fetched manifest against the requested digest, and the bundled registry/proxy pull-through cache consumes it (advisory GHSA-685w-q87j-wqw3; the v2 module path has no fix, only distribution/v3 3.1.2). This image links other packages of the module (registry/api/errcode, registry/api/v2, reference) but not registry/client or registry/proxy. Verified on 2026-11-11 against every published version: each flagged binary was extracted from GHCR and searched for Go symbol names under docker/distribution/registry/client. and docker/distribution/registry/proxy. (the function table keeps them in stripped binaries); every one returned 0 matches, while connaisseur and harbor-registry, which do link the client, returned matches. The melange recipe repeats that search on every build output and fails the build if one appears.
